The Taoglas Blade TD.95.6H31 is a high-performance, omnidirectional N-Type Male mount dipole antenna designed for Meshtastic/MeshCore LoRa communication. It has exceptional performance in the 915MHz spectrum, but also performs well at 868MHz making it an ideal broadband antenna, a perfect universal antenna for use worldwide with excellent efficiency and gain characteristics. The TD.95 features a robust PC/ABS enclosure, ideal for indoor/outdoor applications. This antenna performs excellent without a ground plane – 3dBi Gain with an Omni-directional pattern for constant reception/transmission.
